dct_description_sm: This dataset is a custom tabulation of the 2006 Census of Canada containing shelter cost statistics (rent, electricity, fuel, water and other municipal services, mortgage payments, property taxes and condominium fees) for private households in non-band non-farm non-reserve occupied private dwellings in the City of Toronto.
dct_rights_sm: This dataset is made available without information on how it can be used. You should communicate with the Contact(s) specified before use.
dct_title_s: 2006 Census of Canada, Shelter Costs at the Dissemination Area (DA) Level in the City of Toronto Census Subdivision (CSD) [custom tabulation]
